title: Rights, License & Use-Capability Matrix
objective: Record evidence for private use, transform, campaign use, export, redistribution, commercial use and unknown/denied/revoked states. Downstream systems must filter actions through these capabilities.

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-10
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-10 is completed_verified and owns batch import transaction/recovery semantics.
ARI-11 may define evidence-backed rights, license and use-capability states only after its own governed start.
Unknown, denied and revoked states must remain explicit; resource existence, source identity or prior import acceptance must not silently grant use capabilities.
ARI-12 visual derivative work and all later ARI implementation remain inactive until ARI-11 is completed_verified.
next_action: On the next execution Continue, governed-start ARI-11 only and carry it through its bounded rights/license/use-capability gate before advancing to ARI-12.
